name: Volumetric Clouds from Base Shape (Nubis/Frostbite Hybrid)
definition: A volumetric cloud rendering technique where the cloud layer is defined by two altitudes above a base shape (e.g., a planet). It uses Schneider's density model (from Horizon Zero Dawn's Nubis) and Hillaire 2016 light transport (from Frostbite). The cloud layer follows any base kind because noise is read at the 3D point in the shading frame, avoiding 2D weather map tearing on curved bases.
summary: This method renders volumetric clouds as a spherical shell conforming to base geometry, distinguished by its camera-centred direction grid and explicit lifting above terrain to avoid depth-compositing artifacts.
